blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A former official of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) on Thursday admitted to being “incompetent” to testify that former Sen. Bong Revilla allegedly received kickbacks from government infrastructure projects. Former DPWH National Capital Region (NCR) Director Gerard Opulencia made the admission during the continuation of the trial of Revilla and his co-accused in their graft case involving an alleged P92.8-million “ghost” flood control project in Pandi, Bulacan. READ: Difference case, different witness, same ‘25%’ kickback rate bared In his judicial affidavit read by defense counsel Atty.
